notes.title: Update - 0.1.3.1
notes.content: [p]The 0.1.3.1 version of the game is now out. This is just a small patch.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed some typos.[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs can now get hurt by steam pipes.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/eeacef6de0426875a0147671c1cfb55b5d76b73f.png"][/img][/p][p]There was a typo that was going to drive me insane. Thanks![/p]

notes.title: Update - 0.1.3.0
notes.content: [p]The 0.1.3.0 version of the game is now out. Added some quality-of-life improvements and fixed quite a few bugs.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the flames on the loading screen sometimes not appearing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a performance issue after dying and loading back in.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the hexaltar sound stopping when visiting an already activated hexaltar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues that occurred when dying while resting or warping at a hexaltar, or having certain menus open.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the oxygen meter sometimes not appearing when underwater.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the player's camera after drowning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some geometry in the waterways that NPCs would fall through.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a physical armor pickup in the Auranum Keep that had the wrong pickup text.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some typos.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some damage triggers that had the wrong damage type.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the indicator at the end of dialog creating a line break if near the edge of the dialog box.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the 'æ' character formatting.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed runic power pickups not playing an ambient sound they were supposed to.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some NPC attack animations not playing if the previous animation was an attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an intermittent issue where you couldn't move after warping.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some key decals not deactivating when they should.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a soft-lock occurring when you die without reclaiming a hexaltar (player now respawns at the first hexaltar, even if it hasn't been activated.)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed at out of bounds location in the Auranum Keep.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance in some spots between area transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a button for deleting save files.[/p][/*][*][p]Gibs now float in water.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the Splintershot's reload a little slower (from 4 seconds to 5 seconds).[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the brightness of the boss meter.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the contrast between the page background and text when reading notes/books.[/p][/*][*][p]Footsteps no longer play the same sound twice in a row.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the scroll sensitivity for dialog options.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the appearance of runic power pickups.[/p][/*][*][p]Switched the Runic Dagger's primary and secondary fire, so the primary attack is now the light attack, and the secondary attack is now the heavy attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Melee attacking enemies now must be facing the target to do damage, and will turn to face their target before they attack (previously, enemies could damage the player, even if the player was behind them).[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now "lose interest" in the player when a boss fight begins.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated NPC navigation in the keep.[/p][/*][*][p]Made item pickups more noticeable.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed how gibs calculate force when they're created.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a tutorial message to the shrine in the Auranum Keep.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option for enabling or disabling camera tilt when moving.[/p][/*][*][p]Made Herra only invulnerable during her dash attack, and not the lead up to it. Made it more obvious when she's invulnerable.[/p][/*][*][p]Elevators now reset their position after you die.[/p][/*][*][p]When trying to pickup something you are full on (health, armor, ammo), a message displays indicating why you can't pick it up.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/fed19f62e3260742df2346ced325db327d415c90.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The next major update, which will feature a new weapon, enemies, and a new area "the township," is currently underway! The game will release in early access at this time as well. If you'd like to submit a bug report or leave feedback, you can make a post on the Steam community forums for the game, or check out our [url="steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2F93Y4kRJznv"]Discord[/url].[/p]

notes.title: Update - 0.1.2.0
notes.content: [p]The 0.1.2.0 version of the game is out. There are a few improvements here, but mostly bug fixes. Thanks to everyone who made suggestions and caught these bugs! [/p][list][*][p]Some ranged attacking enemies now move after firing, making them more dynamic and their attack pattern less predictable.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now back out of menus with the back button (escape by default).[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the water texture.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the brightness of the screen tint while underwater, and made the underwater screen effects also apply to the player's weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an audio filter when underwater.[/p][/*][*][p]When dashing, gravity will no longer effect the player for a short period. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some level geometry with an incorrect texture in the Auranum Keep.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the player's "piety" level not getting saved correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed losing your runeglass with "skrillhaven compartment" equipped, even when you shouldn't.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the underwater ambience sometimes not playing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed water enter/exit sounds sometimes not playing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed resolution being set to the smallest option when clicking "reset to default" on the video options menu. Now uses native resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some text in the journal. "Magical armor" should have been "emyrill armor."[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/56fc4d463e4a21b6bb6a28af37cdce8d814d49bf.png"][/img][/p][p]More improvements and fixes will be on the way! If you'd like to submit a bug report or leave feedback, you can make a post on the Steam community forums for the game, or check out our [url="steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2F93Y4kRJznv"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Runeblight Demo Available July 15th
notes.content:
[p]The demo for Runeblight will be available [b]July 15th[/b] on Steam and Itch!! While it's still in early access, I'm happy to be able to show off what we have so far! Here's the trailer![/p][previewyoutube="9QwwVsMsdpI;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]What's in the demo?[/h2][p]The demo features [b]two areas[/b], and the game's hub. There are [b]three weapons[/b], [b]five different types of enemies[/b], [b]a boss[/b], and [b]ten runic powers[/b] to collect (although some of them are harder to find than others). Now that we have a fairly solid base for the game, I wanted to release a demo that gives a taste of what's to come. It's still in early access, so there might be some bugs and things in need of improvement. We're very interested in hearing feedback to help us make the game even better.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Auranum Keep[/h3][p]This is the first area the game, and the starting point for your journey. Here, the Auranum Order houses prisoners to await their execution. The spreading blight has left the keep in dilapidated state — which is good for you, as it allows for your escape.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/c013db8bc26824a43f48b94d699a48ce2622523a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/a0ac74669e54a18fec974b0f21b633a6d5617227.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/8f323557f553cf10466599c3d57c15dda12b5f0d.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]This smaller area serves as a tutorial, introducing the player to some of the game's mechanics and providing their first weapons. It is here the [b]Runic Dagger[/b] and the [b]Splintershot [/b]can be found. Using them, the player can fight their way through the Auranum Cultists until they make their way to the keep's outskirts. A boss fight holds the path closed.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Traitors' Respite[/h3][p]This location is the game's hub. This temple, which once served as the heart of the resistance to the Auranum Order will be the place to return to in between outings. Here, you can [b]level up your stats[/b], and [b]find a few secrets as well[/b].[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/56fc4d463e4a21b6bb6a28af37cdce8d814d49bf.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/c4a27578dad584e7c541dff318f3550a58247fd9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/ef86d5100877bf0447936dd72ec6a417f2a6d499.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]As the game expands I plan for this area to be home to even more mechanics. Eventually, you'll unlock the ability to [b]respec your stats[/b], [b]upgrade your weapons[/b], and [b]trade with merchants[/b]. Friendly NPCs will sometimes make their way back here, and they might be willing to give you a helping hand.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Abandoned Waterways[/h3][p]One of the two paths to the Catacombs are the old waterways. Long ago, it was used by those fleeing the Auranum Order to get to the Traitors' Respite, but now it's been sealed off. This area gives players a peek at what they might expect as they continue the journey through Vilaura.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/4f6d21b1e05063dcf8986a492f0b1525f80eaea0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/73c1828d6d303fa90ab117f568b9f32270b4b598.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/01720f16a6d146187afd274e5087697d36046b01.png"][/img][/carousel][h2]
What's the plan for the game?[/h2][p]After the demo, we'll be working on the next area, "the Township." I'm [i]very[/i] excited to get this completed. This more open-ended level will probably have more content than both the Auranum Keep and Waterways combined, and a part of me wishes I had waited until it was finished to release the demo.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/a3eb518984f9caf2731349381441f693a870765d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/fd429c3e8acb71eb3b628d99388d63a6172ebcd6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/7376a182c543c777140608ea0737bab82c8a6a42.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630984/44ba8f38f26c8242de5c79f5f763b3d3727e6661.png"][/img][/carousel][p] The next update for the game should feature this level, along with some improvements and I'm sure bug-fixes as well. This update we'll also probably be launching the game in early access, so it won't be included in the demo, however, general improvements and fixes will be patched in. [/p][p][/p][p]Overall, the plan is to add more areas, mechanics, weapons, enemies, and bosses as a series of updates. As the game grows in size, its price will increase, so getting in early helps support the game and you can get it for cheaper! Eventually I'll be posting a roadmap detailing the order in which we plan to add new stuff. Keep in mind that as with all early access games, plans change and not everything may come to fruition, but I'm very excited to keep working on new stuff![/p][p][/p][p]If you'd like to get involved with development, play the demo and check out our Discord (linked below)! We'd love to hear your thoughts on it. May the moon light thy path.[/p]
